【AI-Review】【建议】【基础代码问题】【验证问题】
● 问题: 本次 PR 新增的私有方法 `languageIdWithRegion`（第 116-125 行）含 5 条分支：① `systemRegion.length === 0` 直接返回原值（第 118 行）；② `locale.language.length === 0` 直接返回原值（第 118 行）；③ `locale.region.length > 0` 直接返回原值（第 118 行）；④ 含 script 时合成 `language-script-region`（第 122 行）；⑤ 仅 language 时合成 `language-region`（第 124 行）。`sendLocaleToFlutter`（第 98-110 行）也新增了"preferred list 非空 → 逐项调用 `languageIdWithRegion` 合成"与"为空 → 回退 `getSystemLocale()`"两条分支。但同目录测试 `LocalizationPlugin.test.ets` 未新增任何用例覆盖这些分支：现有 `testSendLocaleToFlutter`（第 49-57 行）仅 `try/catch` 做 crash-cover，`sendLocales encodes...`（第 59-71 行）直接调用 `sendLocales(['zh-Hans-CN'])`，完全绕过 `languageIdWithRegion` 的合成逻辑。

● 影响: 后续若 `languageIdWithRegion` 的合成规则被误改（如 script/region 判定条件调整、分隔符从 `-` 改为其他、`locale.language` 归一化逻辑变化、`systemRegion` 为空时的回退路径变更），现有测试均无法捕获，将导致 `PlatformDispatcher.locales` 收到错误的 locale 字段，影响 `MaterialApp` 的 locale 解析与本地化资源匹配——这正是本 PR 要修复的回归方向。

● 建议: 在 `LocalizationPlugin.test.ets` 中新增用例覆盖 `languageIdWithRegion` 各分支。由于该方法是 `private`，可将可见性调整为包级（去除 `private`）以便测试直接调用，或通过 mock `i18n.System.getPreferredLanguageList`/`getSystemRegion` 配合 `RecordingInvoke` 拦截 `localizationChannel.channel`，断言最终 `invokeMethod('setLocale', ...)` 的 4*N 字段负载，覆盖：language-only 输入、script+language 输入、已含 region 输入、`systemRegion` 为空、多语言列表等场景。

pull.title: fix: send preferred locales with region to Flutter
pull.body:
## Why are these changes being made?

The OHOS embedding sent a single system locale to Flutter, so PlatformDispatcher.locales lost the user's preferred language list and MaterialApp could fall back to the wrong locale. HarmonyOS stores the language list and the region separately. sendLocaleToFlutter() now sends the full preferred list, keeps a region that is already present, and fills getSystemRegion() when a language id has none.

## Changelog

- LocalizationPlugin.sendLocaleToFlutter() reads i18n.System.getPreferredLanguageList() and sends that list.
- A language id that already has a region stays unchanged. A language id without a region is combined with i18n.System.getSystemRegion(), and a script is kept when one is present (zh-Hans plus region CN becomes zh-Hans-CN).

## Test Plan

- On HOP-AL00 after removing the empty-list fallback, getPreferredLanguageList() was ja, zh-Hans, en-Latn-US, zh-Hant, ko. PlatformDispatcher.locales was ja_CN, zh_Hans_CN, en_Latn_US, zh_Hant_CN, ko_CN. MaterialApp resolved to zh.

## Checklist

- [x] No illegal compatibility changes are involved.
- [x] No performance issues are present.
- [x] Compliant with the corresponding coding standards.
- [x] No document updates are required.
- [x] Necessary self-test verification has been completed.
- [x] No illegal file introductions exist.
- [x] The branch that needs to be merged has been confirmed.
  - [x] oh-3.44.9-dev
